resources.string: Drag and release to snap your pet to the nearest screen edge. Tap your pet to show or hide task bubbles, or tap a bubble for actions. The cross-app overlay hides when you return to Operit.
Pet: tap to show or hide task bubbles, drag to move
Show your pet and task progress when you leave the app
Unable to show the pet. Check overlay permission and try again.
Bubbles face inward: below the pet at the top edge, above it at the bottom edge. Bubbles hide while dragging and return on release.
Set a resting animation first. Other states are optional and use the resting animation when unset. Greetings play once, then return to the current state.
Import a complete Codex v2 pack with a state spritesheet. Clearing it restores the built-in Shuiqingmiao.
This file does not match the pet configuration format. Your current settings are unchanged.
This pet was removed. The imported file was not retained.
Remove this pet and its artwork copy stored in the app? Your original file is unaffected.
Create a pet configuration, choose its format, then assign files to individual states. Select one pet to display; each keeps its own appearance and dock position.

Assign one file per animation in the configuration format, up to 16 MB each. MP4 loops silently; GIF loops; PNG/WebP displays a static image. Files are copied into the app; replacing an animation never modifies your original file. Codex v2 ZIP packs require a 1536 × 2288 spritesheet.
Import failed. Your current artwork is unchanged. Check the file and try again.
The file, unpacked artwork or pack metadata exceeds its size limit. Your current artwork is unchanged.
Invalid pet pack: include one pet.json with spriteVersionNumber 2 and the image named by spritesheetPath.
Invalid image. Use PNG/WebP/GIF up to 16 megapixels; Codex v2 sheets must be 1536 × 2288.
Invalid video or unsupported codec. Choose an MP4 with video frames this device can play (up to 16 megapixels).
Unable to play artwork. Import it again or select another pet in assistant settings.
